sunlit.tip.auto_claim: Placing a chest, bed, crab trap or machine claims and protects the chunk on its own.
sunlit.tip.hostile_spawns: Hostile mobs can be turned on or off with the button next to Difficulty in Options.
sunlit.tip.sneak_gifts: Sneak while right clicking a villager to give food as a gift without eating it.
sunlit.tip.professions: Pick a profession by signing a contract in the Professions chapter of the quest book.
sunlit.tip.profession_xp: Your profession gets its own Specialties and 50% more experience in its skill tree.
sunlit.tip.profession_crystals: The Crystal of Ambition: Professions from the Guild unlocks one more profession.
sunlit.tip.phone_contacts: Each profession has its own contact on the Phone, like the Grocer for the Cook.
sunlit.tip.mercantile: Selling, gifting, chatting with villagers and turning in contracts levels up the Mercantile tree.
sunlit.tip.bounty_board_xp: Turning in a bounty at the Bounty Board gives Mercantile experience, more for rarer ones.
sunlit.tip.first_dish: The first time you cook each dish, you earn its sell value in coins and Cooking experience.
sunlit.tip.hands_on_cooking: Farmer's Delight stations are cooked on with your own hands, right in the world.
sunlit.tip.pet_affection: The first empty hand click of the day pets your animal and shows its hearts.
sunlit.tip.pet_bonus: Pets with 5 hearts or more get bonuses: faster horses, tougher dogs and more agile cats.
sunlit.tip.artisan_create: The Artisan sells every Create machine and part you need to progress.
sunlit.tip.gravel_nuggets: Crushing gravel gives ore nuggets, so a basic ore farm works with cobblestone alone.
sunlit.tip.temperature: Lit ovens, stoves and fireplaces warm you up, and coats from the Sewing Table help in the cold.
sunlit.tip.exercise_heat: Running nonstop or hanging on ledges warms your body up little by little.
sunlit.tip.longer_day: Days here last about 15 minutes of daylight, so there is more time for the farm.
sunlit.tip.towns: The villages are alive: every villager has a home, and town chests can hold useful finds.
sunlit.tip.plonk: Press R to place any item on a surface, like a plate of food on a table.
sunlit.tip.welcome_guides: Lost? The Guides are in the Welcome chapter of the quest book.
